subject: Edge fanout: capacity bridge and term amendment
messages:
From: Jordan Ames <j.ames@clearpathhealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + private edge rollout at renewal (need capacity & isolation)

Hi Rafael,

We're coming up on our Redwood contract renewal (Sept 30) and we need to fold in a new private footprint for three regional edge sites (US-West, US-East, EU-West). High level asks: additional 4 GPU clusters (2x west, 1x east, 1x eu), per-cluster isolation (VPCs + tenant carveouts), and a 12-month committed term extension with an option to add burst pool capacity.

I've attached a spreadsheet with site details and expected qps. Can you share an updated quote and a quick plan for lead times? Procurement is sensitive to term alignment and we'd like any agreed amendments in place before the renewal cutoff.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Ames
Director, IT Infrastructure
ClearPath Health

Attachment: ClearPath_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Ames <j.ames@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + private edge rollout at renewal (need capacity & isolation)

Thanks Jordan — really clear. Appreciate the spreadsheet.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I'll pull together a draft commercial (capacity + term options) and share by EOD tomorrow.
- We'll need to validate region-specific resource availability for the EU cluster; early book helps guarantee lead times.
- Can we run a 30m call Thurs to confirm expected traffic profiles and RTO/backup needs? Marissa is looped for contracting cadence.

Prelim ask: do you prefer a 12-month firm commit with a 15% upfront credit, or a 24-month with a blended lower unit price (we can model both). Also flagging procurement scope: if you require a private control plane (VPC-hosted control plane) vs. hosted control plane with private VPCs for inference, that changes lead time by 2–4 weeks.

I attached a quick draft quote (RDW-quote-v1.pdf) — pricing placeholder pending engineering sizing confirmation.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: RDW-quote-v1.pdf (pdf, 78 KB)

Jordan — welcome, and thanks for the clear brief.

Couple of commercial points from our side:
- For a 12-month add-on aligned to your Sept 30 renewal we can offer a 10% volume discount on the additional committed capacity (clusters) if signatures are returned within 3 weeks.
- If you go 24 months we can structure a stepped discount + a guaranteed burst pool credit.

Operational asks before we lock:
1) SOC 2 evidence and data retention constraints (we'll bundle required artifacts).
2) Network peering topology and whether you require private control plane (Rafael flagged difference in lead time).

I've looped in Priyom from infra to outline the ops plan and lead times. Rafael — once Priyom confirms the technical windows I'll convert this into a SOW we can attach to the renewal amendment.

Best,

Subject: Re: Renewal + private edge rollout at renewal (need capacity & isolation)

Folks — scope and ops notes from infra: 

- Isolation model: we recommend per-cluster VPCs with tenant carveouts and network ACLs; control plane can remain hosted if ClearPath does not require an air-gapped control plane. Hosted control plane -> ~3 week lead (EU validation adds ~1 week). Private control plane (VPC-hosted control plane) -> +3 weeks for packaging and key management setup.
- Cluster provisioning time: 2–3 weeks per US cluster, 3–4 weeks for EU (due to compliance checks). We can parallelize provisioning across regions provided purchase order and network peering details are finalized.
- Data residency: we need confirmation of retention windows per site. If there are cross-border replication constraints we must flag for legal; that could affect SLA.
- We will deliver an \"isolation runbook\" (ops checklist) and a phased rollout: Phase 1 (west sites), Phase 2 (east + EU). Phased plan reduces risk and allows capacity ramping.

Attaching the ops checklist draft for your review.

Priyom Das
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: isolation-ops-runbook.md (markdown, 12 KB)
